title.zh-CN: 拉取历史记录并核对完整性

question.en-US: What does the source actually cover?

finding.en-US: 191 monthly partitions contain 2,749,081 report/period records; all payload hashes were checked.
finding.zh-CN: 191个月共2749081条研报预测记录，逐月载荷哈希已核对。

decision.en-US: Keep vendor records private and retain annual coverage.
decision.zh-CN: 原始研报留在数据平台，页面展示逐年覆盖。

title.zh-CN: 核对历史数据何时可见

question.en-US: Can old report dates establish original availability?
question.zh-CN: 旧研报的日期能支持多长的历史检验？

finding.en-US: 2011 provider updates are in 2022; the provider-clock cohort begins in May 2022.
finding.zh-CN: 2011年记录的供应商更新时间在2022年，供应商时间口径从2022年5月起有足够样本。

decision.en-US: Retain separate full-history and matched-clock comparisons.
decision.zh-CN: 分别保留完整历史结果和同样本时间口径对照。

question.en-US: Which association remains after exposure controls?
question.zh-CN: 扣除行业和市值影响后，哪些关系还存在？

finding.en-US: Adjusted report-clock profit-revision RankIC is 0.00149; forward yield is 0.03649.
finding.zh-CN: 研报日期口径中，上调幅度的调整后排名相关系数为0.00149，预期盈利相对市值为0.03649。

decision.en-US: Keep all definitions as research candidates; no trading rule is promoted.
decision.zh-CN: 四类定义继续保留为研究候选，交易规则仍需验证。

title.zh-CN: 保留价格缺失和费用限制

question.en-US: Can the return diagnostic support an investable strategy?
question.zh-CN: 现有收益结果离实际交易还有多远？

finding.en-US: Adjusted spread samples have only 46–54 complete months. All 10-bps net-spread intervals include zero.
finding.zh-CN: 调整后的分组收益各有46至54个完整月份。单边费用0.10％时，四项净收益差的不确定区间都包含零。

decision.en-US: Resolve terminal events and observe genuinely later snapshots before promotion.
decision.zh-CN: 继续核对终止事件，并积累新观察日版本及随后结果。

next_question.zh-CN: 在新观察日版本中，预测信息能否比当前已公布盈利多提供一些帮助？
